colorways.name: Light Grey
colorways.logo: Woven tag, light grey ground, Bellwether Blue logo

fit: Relaxed with a slight drop shoulder.
fabric: Stretch 21-wale needlecord, 99% cotton / 1% elastane, about 305 gsm, 5% weft stretch
finish: Garment washed, finished with a silicone softener. Fusing on the inner plies only, so the pile stays soft.
details: 1 1/4 in box placket, six 18L natural corozo buttons
One chest patch pocket, square corners
Square single-button barrel cuffs, tower sleeve plackets
Front yoke seam; plain back with a two-ply yoke
One-piece sleeve, no seam down the back of the arm
Shirttail hem, back 1 in longer than front
Woven digs tag at the foot of the placket; no back embroidery

builtLikeThis.label: Placket tag
builtLikeThis.spec: Woven damask, 1 x 3 in, light grey ground, Bellwether Blue logo, reads up
builtLikeThis.where: Buttonhole placket, bottom edge 1 in above the hem

builtLikeThis.label: Chest pocket
builtLikeThis.spec: Patch pocket, square corners, 1 in top hem

care: Machine wash cold inside out with like colors.
Do not tumble dry. Line dry.
Cool iron on reverse; do not iron the pile face.

origin.status: Label copy reads Made in China; the pack says change to the factory's country.

openItems: Fabric: the reference mill stocks this needlecord in navy and black only; light grey is a custom dye.
